description.es-ES: Los directorios de San Ignacio para dar los Ejercicios: el Directorio autógrafo, las notas dadas de palabra (recogidas por Polanco) y el Directorio dictado al P. Vitoria (hacia 1555).
description.en-US: St. Ignatius's directories for giving the Exercises: the autograph Directory, the notes given by word of mouth (taken down by Polanco) and the Directory dictated to Fr. Vitoria (c. 1555). Spanish only for now.
description.pt-BR: Os diretórios de Santo Inácio para dar os Exercícios: o Diretório autógrafo, as notas dadas de viva voz (recolhidas por Polanco) e o Diretório ditado ao P. Vitória (por volta de 1555).

es-ES.editor: Documenta Catholica Omnia, from Monumenta Ignatiana Series II (Exercitia spiritualia et eorum Directoria)

sources.edition: Directorios de Ejercicios, Documenta Catholica Omnia PDF: the autograph Directory (chapters 1-3), the notes given by word of mouth (Polanco) and the Directory dictated to Vitoria. Page numbers removed.
sources.description: Rubrics and chapter titles printed in capitals in the PDF are kept as they stand inside the first paragraph of each part. The English of Longridge (1919) appends a Directory but does not follow these divisions.
sources.tierEvidence: Sixteenth-century texts dictated or written by Ignatius; distributed by Documenta Catholica Omnia without any copyright claim or licence; free in practice.
